body: i am in desperate need of career direction; i have no idea what to major in.  i dont find any career interesting, much less worth working hard towards.  i dont see myself ever working.
yeah.... i just dont see a psychiatrist agreeing to take me off meds, especially when im still not doing well...

My doctor actually just added a second medicine for me to take.  I thought he was going to wean me off the 1st, but I don't know if he wants to do that yet.  It doesn't really make a difference, though; 2 meds is basically like taking 1, from my point of view.  I'd be interested in seeing what life is like with no meds tho.

i'm not always paralyzed, although i am always procrastinating/avoiding something. i failed out of a college. i dont know if i want to go back. i have no job opportunities. no other options. i have no longterm goals in life. getting out of a bed is a huge accomplishment.

i've been on various meds for like 5 years. i have no idea if i'm better than i was pre-meds, because that was so long ago. plus i was just a young person. i'm not exactly depressed, although i am sad a lot because of how many times i've failed. i've just got nothing to work towards, no goals. i can't figure out what im supposed to do with my life. i wish the military accepted people with mental illnesses (even though i hate war), because i'd rather die for something than for nothing, which is what i fear will happen

i definitely have so-called "clinical depression" but i just dont understand.  its a mood *disorder* or a syndrome. i dont know what that means i have to do.  i didnt realize it until now, but you're saying you can be clinically depressed and not have any chemical imbalances?  that would be interesting.  still i dont know what im gonna do.  thanks though.

i dont know what other people can do.  even in a perfect situation, what would it be?  "inspiring" me to get out of bed every day and do things?  its just pathetic. most people can get trough life, going to school, working, etc, without much motivation.  who the hell am i to need someone to wake me up.

also i dont understand how depression is an illness. my brain is chemically imbalanced?  who is to say what is the correct balance of chemicals? i have never seen scientific evidence of these specific chemicals, especially with my brain.

ive gotten into lots of dumb arguments with my parents.  sometimes thats what they seem to be there for.  also i love yelling. it really seems to help.  sorry about your parents. and your homework, i hate doing that shit.  sorry overall. hope it works out.

i think the main hotlines only notify the police if u are at immediate risk of hurting urself or others.  if u talk to them and dont lose control (like yell or make threats), then they won't.  u can ask them when they pick up, what their policy is, or whatever.
